planning_notes: The request for 5 HARD targets was fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct concepts from the available 7 and assigning each a unique, high-cognitive-load pedagogical facet. To ensure 'HARD' difficulty, the facets were chosen to require synthesis, error diagnosis, or boundary analysis rather than simple recall. Specifically: 1) Binary Search Partitioning Strategy was assessed via MISCONCEPTION_TARGETING to test deep understanding of the partition invariant. 2) Partition Boundary Properties were assessed via BOUNDARY_EDGE_CASE to test handling of empty partitions. 3) Median Calculation Logic was assessed via OFF_BY_ONE_ANALYSIS to test integer division and index arithmetic. 4) Cross-Array Comparison Conditions were assessed via ERROR_DIAGNOSIS to test logic flow and condition checking. 5) Pointer Adjustment and Search Direction were assessed via OUTPUT_PREDICTION to test precise state tracing through a complex execution path.
